181:             panic!("Invalid route: empty path");
182:         }
183: 
184:         self.run_path_probes(path);
185: 
186:         let service = match try_downcast::<Router<B>, _>(service) {
187:             Ok(_) => {
188:                 panic!("Invalid route: `Router::route` cannot be used with `Router`s. Use `Router::nest` instead")
189:             }
190:             Err(svc) => svc,
191:         };
192: 
193:         let id = RouteId::next();
194: 
195:         let service = match try_downcast::<MethodRouter<B, Infallible>, _>(service) {
196:             Ok(method_router) => {
197:                 if let Some((route_id, Endpoint::MethodRouter(prev_method_router))) = self
198:                     .node
199:                     .path_to_route_id
200:                     .get(path)
201:                     .and_then(|route_id| self.routes.get(route_id).map(|svc| (*route_id, svc)))
202:                 {
203:                     // if we're adding a new `MethodRouter` to a route that already has one just
204:                     // merge them. This makes `.route("/", get(_)).route("/", post(_))` work
205:                     let service =
206:                         Endpoint::MethodRouter(prev_method_router.clone().merge(method_router));
207:                     self.routes.insert(route_id, service);
208:                     return self;
209:                 } else {
210:                     Endpoint::MethodRouter(method_router)
211:                 }
212:             }
213:             Err(service) => Endpoint::Route(Route::new(service)),
214:         };
215: 
216:         if let Err(err) = self.node.insert(path, id) {
217:             self.panic_on_matchit_error(err);
218:         }
219: 
220:         self.routes.insert(id, service);
221: 
222:         self

225:     #[doc = include_str!("../docs/routing/nest.md")]
226:     pub fn nest<T>(mut self, path: &str, svc: T) -> Self
227:     where
228:         T: Service<Request<B>, Response = Response, Error = Infallible> + Clone + Send + 'static,
229:         T::Future: Send + 'static,
230:     {
231:         if path.is_empty() {
232:             panic!("Invalid route: empty path");
233:         }
234: 
235:         if path.contains('*') {
236:             panic!("Invalid route: nested routes cannot contain wildcards (*)");
237:         }
238: 
239:         let prefix = path;
240:         self.run_path_probes(prefix);
241: 
242:         if path == "/" {
243:             self.nested_at_root = true;
244:         }
245: 
246:         match try_downcast::<Router<B>, _>(svc) {
247:             // if the user is nesting a `Router` we can implement nesting
248:             // by simplying copying all the routes and adding the prefix in
249:             // front
250:             Ok(router) => {
251:                 let Router {
252:                     mut routes,
253:                     node,
254:                     fallback,
255:                     // nesting a router that has something nested at root
256:                     // doesn't mean something is nested at root in _this_ router
257:                     // thus we don't need to propagate that
258:                     nested_at_root: _,
259:                     ..
260:                 } = router;
261: 
262:                 if let Fallback::Custom(_) = fallback {
263:                     panic!("Cannot nest `Router`s that has a fallback");
264:                 }
265: 
266:                 for (id, nested_path) in node.route_id_to_path {
267:                     let route = routes.remove(&id).unwrap();
268:                     let full_path = self.compose_nested_route_path(path, nested_path.as_ref());
269:                     self = match route {
270:                         Endpoint::MethodRouter(method_router) => self.route(
271:                             &full_path,
272:                             method_router.layer(layer_fn(|s| StripPrefix::new(s, prefix))),
273:                         ),
274:                         Endpoint::Route(route) => {
275:                             self.route(&full_path, StripPrefix::new(route, prefix))
276:                         }
277:                     };
278:                 }
279: 
280:                 debug_assert!(routes.is_empty());
281:             }
282:             // otherwise we add a wildcard route to the service
283:             Err(svc) => {
284:                 let path = self.compose_nested_wildcard_path(path);
285: 
286:                 self = self.route(&path, strip_prefix::StripPrefix::new(svc, prefix));
287:             }
288:         }
289: 
290:         self
291:     }

445:     #[inline]
446:     fn call_route(&self, match_: matchit::Match<&RouteId>, mut req: Request<B>) -> RouterFuture<B> {
447:         let id = *match_.value;
448:         req.extensions_mut().insert(id);

450:         if let Some(matched_path) = self.node.route_id_to_path.get(&id) {
451:             let matched_path = if let Some(previous) = req.extensions_mut().get::<MatchedPath>() {
452:                 // a previous `MatchedPath` might exist if we're inside a nested Router
453:                 let previous = if let Some(previous) =
454:                     previous.as_str().strip_suffix(NEST_TAIL_PARAM_CAPTURE)
455:                 {
456:                     previous
457:                 } else {
458:                     previous.as_str()
459:                 };
460: 
461:                 let matched_path = format!("{}{}", previous, matched_path);
462:                 matched_path.into()
463:             } else {
464:                 Arc::clone(matched_path)
465:             };
466:             req.extensions_mut().insert(MatchedPath(matched_path));
467:         } else {
468:             #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
469:             panic!("should always have a matched path for a route id");
470:         }
471: 
472:         let params = match_
473:             .params
474:             .iter()
475:             .filter(|(key, _)| !key.starts_with(NEST_TAIL_PARAM))
476:             .map(|(key, value)| (key.to_owned(), value.to_owned()))
477:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();

479:         insert_url_params(&mut req, params);

481:         let mut route = self
482:             .routes
483:             .get(&id)
484:             .expect("no route for id. This is a bug in axum. Please file an issue")
485:             .clone();

487:         let future = match &mut route {
488:             Endpoint::MethodRouter(inner) => inner.call(req),
489:             Endpoint::Route(inner) => inner.call(req),
490:         };
491:         RouterFuture::from_future(future)

560: fn with_path(uri: &Uri, new_path: &str) -> Uri {
561:     let path_and_query = if let Some(path_and_query) = uri.path_and_query() {
562:         let new_path = if new_path.starts_with('/') {
563:             Cow::Borrowed(new_path)
564:         } else {
565:             Cow::Owned(format!("/{}", new_path))
566:         };
567: 
568:         if let Some(query) = path_and_query.query() {
569:             Some(
570:                 format!("{}?{}", new_path, query)
571:                     .parse::<http::uri::PathAndQuery>()
572:                     .unwrap(),
573:             )
574:         } else {
575:             Some(new_path.parse().unwrap())
576:         }
577:     } else {
578:         None
579:     };
580: 
581:     let mut parts = http::uri::Parts::default();
582:     parts.scheme = uri.scheme().cloned();
583:     parts.authority = uri.authority().cloned();
584:     parts.path_and_query = path_and_query;
585: 
586:     Uri::from_parts(parts).unwrap()
587: }

590: // params using `Result<Path<T>, _>`. That wouldn't be possible if we
591: // returned an error immediately when decoding the param
592: pub(crate) struct UrlParams(
593:     pub(crate) Result<Vec<(ByteStr, PercentDecodedByteStr)>, InvalidUtf8InPathParam>,
594: );

596: fn insert_url_params<B>(req: &mut Request<B>, params: Vec<(String, String)>) {
597:     let params = params
598:         .into_iter()
599:         .map(|(k, v)| {
600:             if let Some(decoded) = PercentDecodedByteStr::new(v) {
601:                 Ok((ByteStr::new(k), decoded))
602:             } else {
603:                 Err(InvalidUtf8InPathParam {
604:                     key: ByteStr::new(k),
605:                 })
606:             }
607:         })
608:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>();
609: 
610:     if let Some(current) = req.extensions_mut().get_mut::<Option<UrlParams>>() {
611:         match params {
612:             Ok(params) => {
613:                 let mut current = current.take().unwrap();
614:                 if let Ok(current) = &mut current.0 {
615:                     current.extend(params);
616:                 }
617:                 req.extensions_mut().insert(Some(current));
618:             }
619:             Err(err) => {
620:                 req.extensions_mut().insert(Some(UrlParams(Err(err))));
621:             }
622:         }
623:     } else {
624:         req.extensions_mut().insert(Some(UrlParams(params)));
625:     }
626: }
